arm64_pattern: (elided in JIT block; yield for pause)
semantics: Zero-cost no-op; advances guest RIP without touching flags or registers

arm64_pattern: mov xd/wd, xn/wn | bfxil xd, xn, #0, #8/#16
semantics: w=32 zeroes bits 63:32; w=8/16 merges into destination via bfxil; flags unchanged

arm64_pattern: ldr/ldrh/ldrb (or ldapr in TSO mode) + bfxil for w=8/16
semantics: Range-checked guest load (+ gs:[disp] TEB support); w=32 zeroes upper 32 bits

arm64_pattern: str/strh/strb (or stlr in TSO mode)
semantics: Range-checked guest store; release semantics under TSO mode

arm64_pattern: movz + movk (up to 4x16b) | bfxil for w=8/16
semantics: Immediate pre-extended/masked; w=32 zeroes bits 63:32; w=8/16 preserves upper bits

arm64_pattern: movz/movk xs, #imm + str/stlr xs, [xa]
semantics: Stores 8/16/32/64-bit sign-extended immediate to guest memory

arm64_pattern: ubfx xd/wd, xn/wn, #0, #8/#16 | ldrb/ldrh + bfxil
semantics: Zero-extends 8/16-bit source to 16/32/64-bit destination

arm64_pattern: sbfx xd/wd, xn/wn, #0, #8/#16/#32
semantics: Sign-extends 8/16/32-bit source to 16/32/64-bit destination

arm64_pattern: add xd, xbase, xindex, lsl #scale + add/sub #disp
semantics: Computes effective address without memory access or flag modification
Sign-extends AL/AX/EAX/RAX into AX/EAX/RAX or DX:AX / EDX:EAX / RDX:RAX

arm64_pattern: mov tmp, r0; mov r0, r1; mov r1, tmp | rev xd/wd, xn/wn | rev16
semantics: Register swap and big-endian byte reversal; flags unchanged

arm64_pattern: ubfx xs, x_gpr, #8, #8 + op + bfi x_gpr, xs, #8, #8
semantics: Bitfield extract/insert on bits [15:8] of RAX/RCX/RDX/RBX with exact 8-bit flags

arm64_pattern: adds/subs xd/wd, xn/wn, xm/wm/#imm (or lsl #24/#16 for w=8/16)
semantics: ARM64 NZCV maps CF={!C for sub, C for add}, ZF=Z, SF=N, OF=V; lazy parity in pfv

arm64_pattern: adcs/sbcs xd/wd, xn/wn, xm/wm (with CF materialized into NZCV.C)
semantics: Full 8/16/32/64-bit carry/borrow chain; SBB inverts ARM64 C bit on input & output

arm64_pattern: ands xd/wd, xn, xm | orr/eor xd, xn, xm + tst
semantics: Clears CF=0, OF=0; sets ZF, SF, PF from result; xor reg,reg zeroes without reading

arm64_pattern: subs/ands wzr/xzr, xn, xm + b.<cond> (macro-fused in JIT)
semantics: Keeps flags in hardware NZCV across adjacent Jcc/CMOVcc/SETcc without memory stores

arm64_pattern: adds/subs xd, xn, #1 (preserving Cpu::cf) | negs xd, xn | mvn xd, xn
semantics: INC/DEC updates OF/SF/ZF/PF while preserving prior CF; NEG sets CF=(src!=0)

arm64_pattern: lslv/lsrv/asrv xd/wd, xn/wn, xm + cbnz count flag update
semantics: Masks shift count to 5/6 bits; count==0 leaves flags untouched (w=32 still zeroes upper 32b)

arm64_pattern: rorv/extr xd/wd, xn/wn, xm/wm, #cnt + CF/OF bit extraction
semantics: Exact modular rotate for 8/16/32/64-bit operands and double-precision funnel shifts

arm64_pattern: rbit + clz + csel (BSF leaves dst unchanged on 0; TZCNT/LZCNT set CF=(src==0); POPCNT uses fmov+cnt.8b+addv.8b)
semantics: Preserves destination register when BSF/BSR source is 0; exact ZF/CF for TZCNT/LZCNT/POPCNT

arm64_pattern: lsrv cf, src, idx; and cf, cf, #1 + lslv mask, #1, idx + orr/bic/eor
semantics: Extracts tested bit into CF and optionally sets/resets/complements bit in destination

arm64_pattern: bics, lslv/lsrv/asrv/ror, umulh, crc32cb/h/w/x, bit-deposit/extract loops
semantics: Flag-free shifts/rotates/mulx, hardware ARM64 CRC32C instruction, dual carry chains (CF/OF)

arm64_pattern: mul xd, xn, xm + smulh/sbfx overflow check -> CF=OF
semantics: Signed product truncated to w bits; sets CF=OF=(full product != sign_ext(low_w))

arm64_pattern: mul + umulh/smulh | udiv/sdiv + msub for RDX:RAX quotient/remainder
semantics: Full 128-bit RDX:RAX multiply/divide and 8/16/32-bit accumulator forms with CF=OF on high half

arm64_pattern: sub x_rsp, x_rsp, #8 + str/stlr | ldr/ldapr + add x_rsp, x_rsp, #8
semantics: Handles push rsp / pop rsp edge cases, enter frame allocation, and 16-bit operand-size stack pointer adjustments

arm64_pattern: Direct patched b/b.<cond> between JIT blocks + lookup_ret/lookup_jmp hash dispatch
semantics: Intercepts host VA_DISPATCH targets & __chkstk; links direct block targets in MAP_JIT

arm64_pattern: csel xd/wd, x_true, x_false, <cond> | cset wd, <cond>
semantics: 32-bit CMOVcc unconditionally zero-extends destination bits 63:32 even when condition is false

arm64_pattern: ldaxr/stlxr retry loop (ldaxp/stlxp for cmpxchg16b) + dmb ish
semantics: SeqCst LL/SC atomic RMW against guest memory; sets ZF=(old==expected) and updates RAX/RDX:RAX

arm64_pattern: Inline ARM64 loop over RCX with DF (+/-width) stepping and ZF termination
semantics: Honors Cpu::df direction flag, RCX count=0 early exit, and REPE/REPNE ZF comparison flags

arm64_pattern: strb/ldrb Cpu flags | ldr/str guest MXCSR (stmxcsr) | ldrb w0, [x_rbx, x_rax, uxtw] (xlatb) | dmb ish / dsb ish+isb (serialize) | native or scaled CNTVCT_EL0 (rdtsc/p) | getentropy via JitScratch::entropy_fn (rdrand/rdseed)
semantics: Direct flag updates, MXCSR stores, xlatb, memory/instruction serialization (SERIALIZE -> DSB ISH + ISB), real OS CSPRNG entropy via getentropy (RDRAND/RDSEED with exact CF/PF/ZF/SF/OF semantics), and 1 GHz guest RDTSC/RDTSCP.

arm64_pattern: blr [XCPU+OFF_SYS_HELPERS].cpuid (host-FPCR guarded, XMM spill/reload) -> w19/w22/w20/w21
semantics: Read guest topology, user instruction capabilities, and enabled state components on the executing thread via the shared cpuid::query table.

arm64_pattern: cbnz w20, #gp + movz w19, #7 (xgetbv) | blr [XCPU+OFF_SYS_HELPERS].xstate with XMM spill/reload and XBUD ymm_dirty sync
semantics: Long-mode FXSAVE and standard or compacted XSAVE images, x87 physical tags, selective initialization, #GP alignment/reserved checks, and MXCSR validation.

arm64_pattern: ldr/str [XCPU+OFF_X87_CW] (fldcw/fnstcw) | ldr m32 + #GP check + str OFF_MXCSR + inline FPCR RMode/FZ/AFP(AH,FIZ) msr fpcr (ldmxcsr/vldmxcsr)
semantics: Inline x87 control-word load/store and native MXCSR->FPCR installation (all 16 RN/RD/RU/RZ x FTZ x DAZ modes native on FEAT_AFP; mixed FTZ!=DAZ exits cleanly to soft_flush on non-AFP).

arm64_pattern: ldr/str q0, [xa] | ins v0.s[0], v1.s[0] | ins v0.d[0], v1.d[0] | dup v0.2d, v1.d[0]
semantics: Legacy SSE preserves YMM bits [255:128]; VEX.128 zeroes YMM upper 128b; VEX.256 processes both 128b lanes

arm64_pattern: fmov s0/d0, wn/xn | umov wn/xn, v0.b/h/s/d[lane] | ins v0.b/h/s/d[lane], wn/xn | ushr+ushl+addv for movmsk
semantics: Zero-latency GPR<->NEON lane transfers, sign-bit mask extraction, and YMM upper-half zeroing

arm64_pattern: dup v0.16b/8h/4s/2d, v1.b/h/s/d[0] | sxtl/uxtl v0.8h/4s/2d, v1.8b/4h/2s
semantics: 128-bit and 256-bit element broadcasts and chained NEON sxtl/uxtl lane widening

arm64_pattern: eor/orr/and v0.16b, v1.16b, v2.16b | bic v0.16b, v2.16b, v1.16b (for pandn !a & b)
semantics: Note operand order reversal on PANDN/ANDNPS -> ARM64 BIC; PTEST sets ZF=(a&b)==0, CF=(!a&b)==0

arm64_pattern: zip1/zip2 | sqxtn+sqxtn2 / sqxtun+sqxtun2 | tbl v0.16b, {v1.16b}, v2.16b | ext v0.16b, v1.16b, v2.16b, #imm | sshr+bsl
semantics: PSHUFB bit 7 zero-masking mapped via BIC+TBL; saturating pack via NEON sqxtn/sqxtun/uqxtn

arm64_pattern: ushr/sshr/shl v0, v1, #imm | ext v0.16b, v1.16b, v_zero, #imm | ushl/sshl v0, v1, v_signed_cnt
semantics: x86 shift counts >= lane width zero (or sign-fill for psraw/psrad) via saturating count clamp before NEON ushl/sshl

arm64_pattern: add/sub | sqadd/uqadd/sqsub/uqsub | addp | uzp1+uzp2+sub | abs
semantics: 1:1 NEON lane-wise wrapping & signed/unsigned saturating arithmetic across 8/16/32/64-bit lanes

arm64_pattern: mul | smull+smull2+uzp2 | umull | smin/smax/umin/umax | urhadd | uabdl+uaddlv
semantics: Widening NEON multiplies + uzp2/addp for high-half products and horizontal multiply-accumulate

arm64_pattern: cmeq/cmgt v0.16b/8h/4s/2d, v1, v2
semantics: Produces all-1s (0xFF..FF) or all-0s per lane matching NEON cmeq/cmgt directly

arm64_pattern: fadd/fsub/fmul/fdiv/fsqrt s0/d0 + ins v_dst.s[0]/d[0] | fcmp+bsl for x86 minss/maxss NaN/signed-zero rules
semantics: Preserves bits [127:32] (ss) or [127:64] (sd) of first source; minss/maxss returns second operand on NaN or -0/+0

arm64_pattern: fadd/fsub/fmul/fdiv/fsqrt v0.4s/2d | fcmgt+bsl for min/max | frintn/m/p/z | faddp | fcmeq/fcmgt
semantics: 128-bit and 256-bit (dual-128b NEON) packed float/double ops with all 32 AVX comparison predicates

arm64_pattern: scvtf | frintn/frintz + fcvtzs + overflow->0x80000000_00000000 check | fcmp + unordered ZF=PF=CF=1

arm64_pattern: fmadd s0/d0, s1, s2, s3 | fmla v0.4s/2d, v1.4s/2d, v2.4s/2d (with fneg on negated terms)
semantics: Single-rounding IEEE-754 fused multiply-add across all 72 FMA3 mnemonics; scalar forms preserve upper bits of dst

arm64_pattern: Two-register NEON (lo=v_lo, hi=v_hi) cross-lane tbl / ins / movi
semantics: Cross-128-bit lane permutations, 128-bit lane insertion/extraction, and full YMM0..15 zeroing

arm64_pattern: Inline VSIB per-lane tbz+umov+sbfm+add(lsl)+ldapr/ldr+ins with element-by-element mask clearing and #UD alias check
semantics: Conditionally gathers 32/64-bit elements using VSIB vector index with restartable per-lane mask clearing, vm64x/VEX.128 upper zeroing, and zero mask on completion

arm64_pattern: aese+aesmc+eor (128b & dual-lane 256b VAES) | pmull (128b & dual-lane 256b VPCLMULQDQ) | fcvtl/fcvtn

arm64_pattern: rev64+ext+sha1c/sha1p/sha1m/sha1su1 | zip+sha256h+sha256h2 / sha256su0 / sha256su1
semantics: Hardware ARMv8 FEAT_SHA1/FEAT_SHA256 lowering for all 7 Intel SHA-NI ops; preserves YMM[255:128]; CPUID leaf 7 EBX bit 29 requires both host SHA extensions

arm64_pattern: uxtl+sxtl+mul.8h+saddlp.4s+addp.4s+add/sqadd | smull+smull2+saddlp.2d+sxtl.2d+add.2d+sqxtn.4s
